name: FibreSeeker3 SK3 CF nozzle
printer_notes: Two-head machine: a 0.7 mm composite head with independently controlled plastic (V) and continuous-fiber (U) channels sharing one orifice, able to print plastic-only, plus a 0.4 mm plastic head (T1) that carries the E moves. The Nozzle diameters field models the E-driven plastic head; the composite orifice size is carried by the Fiber nozzle diameter setting. This variant enables continuous-fiber capability.
machine_start_gcode:
SET_VELOCITY_LIMIT SQUARE_CORNER_VELOCITY=10 ACCEL=10000
SET_PRESSURE_ADVANCE EXTRUDER=extruder1 ADVANCE=0.04
M104 S[first_layer_temperature] T1
M140 S[first_layer_bed_temperature]
M141 S0
G21
G90
M83
G92 E0
G0 Z10 F900
M190 S[first_layer_bed_temperature]
M191 S0
M400
M109 S[first_layer_temperature] T1
T1 ; switch extruder type to:PLASTIC
MOVE_TO_BRUSH_STATION
CLEAN_NOZZLE
MOVE_OUT_BRUSH_STATION
M106 P3 S0
M106 P5 S0
